source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Λεόντιος ο φιλόσοφος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole notice is one sentence — «Ο Άγιος Λεόντιος ο φιλόσοφος απεβίωσε ειρηνικά» — he died in peace, and nothing else. **No `types`**: the page gives him no rank at all, and «φιλόσοφος» is not one of the corpus's type slugs; the two-line verse addresses him as «πάτερ», father, which is not enough to make him a monk in the record, so the field is left out and named in the reader's report. **No `dates`, no `locations`, no `related` and no hymn**: the page gives none of them. The corpus holds sixteen other folders named Leontius; none of them is kept on 19 October in any calendar and none is called a philosopher, so this is a new folder and not an upgrade. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
